messages.stripe.connection.auth-help: Use a Stripe secret key. The integration only reads account and events. Do not commit the key to Git.
messages.stripe.guide.token-note: Create a restricted API key. Do not paste a publishable key.
messages.stripe.oauth.note: Enter the platform Secret Key as the Client Secret. Standard Connect read_write grants write access, though the Molis Work API preview remains read-only.
messages.stripe.oauth.stripe-scope: App authorization scope: read_only for Extension, read_write for standard Connect
